id: title:eli-r-ph:re send a chunk a crashed worker left mid commit

review.posthog_relevance: Adds recovery and interruption handling to the Rust batch-import-worker, potentially preventing worker crash loops and lost data during warehouse ingestion failures.
review.reason: The chunk P1.F2.H4 demonstrates a substantive implementation of recovery and interruption handling, including the addition of recovered_commit fields, rewinding logic, and an interruption counter. This represents a bounded, substantive improvement to the reliability of the batch import worker. P1.F2.H8 adds a recovery marker and entry-point change, supporting the recovery behavior.
review.uncertainty: The chunk P1.F3 and P1.F5 are not supplied, and P1.F4.H1 is not supplied, so the full implementation and database changes are not available. The tier is assigned based on the supplied implementation, not the complete change. No adoption or incident avoidance is inferred.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, complete change group. No unrelated PRs are present. No adoption, incident, or effort claims are used. No tier is assigned; score is withheld.

observations.posthog_connection: This could prevent a worker from repeatedly re-sending a chunk that fails to reach the warehouse, potentially avoiding a crash loop. The implementation rewinds the chunk and checks an offset mismatch or the interruption cap before pausing.
